prompt: Edit this exact sheet of SIX copies of our original red-and-gold pikeman, in the same two rows of three. Preserve the exact painted identity, face, silver helmet and white plume, mail sleeves, red gold-edged tunic, brown boots, body size, shading and colours. EVERY figure keeps EXACTLY the ONE original long wooden pike with its small silver spear point, at the SAME diagonal carrying angle. Do NOT create an axe, halberd, sword, upright extra pole or second weapon. The wider cells already fit the original complete pike, so do NOT shorten or clip it. Change the first FOUR figures' LEGS into a complete WALKING cycle: top left nearer boot planted forward and far boot trailing; top middle far knee and boot passing forward under the body; top right FAR boot planted forward and NEAR boot trailing, opposite lead to the first; bottom left near knee and boot passing forward under the body. Clearly different walking leg silhouettes, same level body and ground plane, no attack, jump or skating. Last TWO bottom middle and bottom right are quiet IDLE rests, both boots planted in their ORIGINAL positions. Only change a small plume fold, fingers on the shaft and a blink between those two rests. Keep all heads, upper bodies and full original pikes in the same positions. Preserve the original charming painted 1996 DOS fantasy strategy game style exactly, no text, labels, new objects or effects.

Keep this exact SIX grey troll sheet, same layout, exact stony faces, heavy bodies, loincloths, bare feet, scale, colours and painted shading. Correct EVERY arm and weapon pose so ALL SIX carry exactly ONE original rough stone club quietly OVER THE SHOULDER, as the top left troll does. Never lower it to the ground, swing it, raise it above the head or prepare an attack. Change the FIRST FOUR legs to a grounded walking cycle: top left near foot planted forward and far foot behind; top middle far foot passing under the body; top right FAR foot planted forward and NEAR foot behind, opposite lead to the first; bottom left near foot passing under the body. Distinct leg silhouettes, level head and chest, no jump or whole-body bounce. Last TWO bottom middle and bottom right stand quietly with BOTH feet planted in the same places and the club always resting on the shoulder. Between these two rests, only blink, relax the free fingers and subtly change belly and shoulder folds. Keep the original troll identity, body proportions, complete club, flat grey background and charming painted 1996 DOS fantasy strategy game style. No extra objects, labels, text or effects.

Keep this exact six-pose GREEN goblin sheet, same faces, bodies, legs, ears, loincloths, poses, size, colours and painted shading. Change ONLY the weapon heads in the LAST TWO bottom middle and bottom right resting figures. Their wooden shafts must end in the SAME ONE simple silver leaf-shaped SPEAR POINT that the first four figures carry. REMOVE the extra side prongs, never a trident or pitchfork. One spear per goblin, same shaft length and complete weapon. Keep those two resting figures' BOTH feet planted, subtle ear, grin and hand changes, and all original walking leg poses of the first four unchanged. Preserve the exact original charming painted 1996 DOS fantasy strategy game style, plain flat grey background and shadows. No new objects, labels, text or effects.
